{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any of the six QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are in the 'loyal' segment
qa_orders_in_loyal = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

print(f"Number of QA orders in loyal segment: {len(qa_orders_in_loyal)}")
print(f"QA orders in loyal segment: {qa_orders_in_loyal[['order_id', 'revenue']].values.tolist()}")"}
